answer: Treat new agent identities like seedlings in a community garden: each must be tended before it earns a plot. A fresh account's reward weight grows only as peers it has no funding links with keep attesting its work over many epochs. Spinning up a thousand clones is no shortcut, because each clone starts at zero and shared payout trails stand out like one pigment bleeding through every canvas. The old fable of the tortoise fits: steady, verified history beats a sudden crowd.
